title: The real watches behind GTA 6
why: Owner request; GTA VI came out 19 Nov 2026. Main source (readable, opened): Esquire UK, 'The Watches of Grand Theft Auto 6 (And the Real-Life Watches They're Based On)', Johnny Davis, 19 Nov 2026, https://www.esquire.com/uk/watches/a74476792/grand-theft-auto-6-watches/ . Use only what Esquire says, with its hedging ('appears to have inspired', 'near dead ringer', 'resembling'). Esquire: in-game brands Crowex (Rolex lookalike), Takio (Casio-adjacent), Covgari (owes more to Audemars Piguet); the game reportedly has 34 collectible luxury watches. Slides (6-7): A-cover tag LISTICLE line1 'The Real Watches' line2 'Behind GTA 6' with photo watch-wire-engine/library/img/rockstar-vi/12.jpg (Rockstar official key art, credit 'Image: Rockstar Games'); then four A-spotted slides, photo = the game image, watch = the real watch inset, credit 'Image: Rockstar Games, via Esquire · Watch: <credit>': (1) gta6-esquire-01.png + commons-rolex-day-date.jpg: label 'In game: Crowex', headline 'Rolex [[Day-Date]] 40', body 'Ref. 228238: fluted bezel, day window, per Esquire.'; (2) gta6-esquire-02.png + rolex-126500ln.png: 'Rolex [[Daytona]]'; (3) gta6-esquire-03.png + rolex-126610ln.png: 'Rolex [[Submariner]]', body mentions Brian Heder; (4) gta6-esquire-04.png + commons-casio-triple-sensor-pro-trek.jpg: 'Casio [[Pro Trek]]', Jason Duval (photo is a Pro Trek PRT-411; say 'a Casio Pro Trek'); then an A-text or A-number slide '34' collectible watches reportedly + Takio = Casio F-91W nod (no photo, the F-91W game image is co-credited and not allowed); cta line1 'Which would you wear', line2 'in Vice City?'. Rockstar images are allowed by owner permission (state/owner-taste.md); rights 'licensed'. Register every photo with photo.js find + CC media-register (rights as listed in library index). Caption: 'Source: Esquire UK (19 Nov 2026). Images: Rockstar Games, via Esquire; watch photos credited on each slide.' Never use the word 'official' about the game watches.
